QuestInfo.name: Dr. Bruce's Research
QuestInfo.0: Go see Dr. Bruce in #m100000000# about his research on the Golem's Temple.
QuestInfo.1: Dr. Bruce needs your help with his research on the Golem's Temple, and named you his assistant. Your first task as assistant is to bring him 40 #t4000022#s from the Stone Golem's. Head over to East of the Windflower Forest, and find the Golem's Temple Entrance.
QuestInfo.2: You found the Golem's Temple Entrance, smashed a bunch of Golems, and brought back #t4000022#s for Dr. Bruce to study.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 500 Can proceed to the Cracked Rubble quest

0.0: Are you interested in Archaeology? I've uncovered some very interesting data on the artifacts at the Golem's Temple in #m100000000#, but I really need a hand with all those monsters. Would you be interested in working as my assistant? I don't like to brag, but I pay pretty darn well.\r\n

yes.0: That's great! I'm so swamped with my research right now! I've got papers to write and toads to electrocute. Don't ask, it's very science-y. So, assistant, you need to go to the Golem's Temple right away. Just head east from the Windflower Forest of the Singing Mushroom Forest to get to the entrance. Now, I can't do any research without samples, can I? Bring me 40 Stone Golem Rubbles from the Stone Golems at the temple entrance. I don't care how you extract them, just do whatever you have to do. And do it fast! I've got a presentation coming up and I can't afford to be late!

no.0: It's really not that hard and it'll look great on your resume! You care about that, right? I can even write some recommendation letters! Dr. Winston and Dr. Betty are both very close colleagues of mine. Why don't you say yes? You should say yes.

1.0: Hey, thanks a lot! These are great! Next time maybe you can try coming back BEFORE my deadline!\r\n

yes.0: You make a pretty good assistant. I'll make you into the real deal!

item.0: All you have to do is head east from the Windflower Forest of the Singing Mushroom Forest and you'll find the Golem's Temple Entrance. You do whatever it is you do to make those Stone Golems give up their precious rubble and bring them back as fast as you can. I think about 40 Stone Golem Rubbles would do it!
